title: A wide component is readable on its Library tile
goal: On the Library shelf, a wide component like a nav bar or a text field shrinks to a smear you cannot tell apart from its neighbour. A tile should show enough of what it is that you can pick the right one without hovering for the tooltip.
notes: Found while auditing the starter set on 2026-09-03. A tile picture is 80 points wide (LibraryPanel.maxTiles grid, LibraryComponentTile.thumbnail, DocumentRenderer.thumbnail maxDimension: 80) and scaledToFit, so a 320x48 nav bar renders about 80x12. Options worth weighing: crop to a square of the interesting part rather than fitting the whole thing, give a wide component a two-column tile, or draw the picture larger and let the grid reflow.
acceptance: Every component on the Components shelf is tellable apart from its neighbours at the shelf's default width
A wide component reads as what it is rather than as a grey line
Nothing about a tall or square component's tile gets worse
